description: OpenSearch 3.9.0 dialect differences: num_reduce_phases, the can-match pre-filter, sliced scrolls over shards, match_all's approximation in validate, docvalue_fields per format, an empty index's translog, terms lookups fetched once, unified matched_fields, BM25 (Lucene's plain BM25Similarity by default, LegacyBM25 on request), and aggregation profile debug maps (filter rewrite counts, terms and cardinality collectors).
